title: All credit to Abel for an informative and interesting tour.
text: Our tour guide Abel was excellent. Very knowledgeable and clearly interested in his subject matter. We were a small group and I felt he dealt with the questions of the group members very well. It was apparently his first tour in English, which was very surprising as it was so good.
author: Sarah_H

title: Great tours in Seville
text: White umbrella is 100% reliable. We booked the free walking tour on our first day, well organised and easy to follow joining instructions by Maria. Then second day tour to Alcaraz. Our guide ‘ Alex/ Alejandro, was brilliant and loved every minute, glad we booked with white umbrella for both experiences, loved them. I would suggest booking your entry tickets from them also.
author: stevejdoc

title: Julio: A friendly, engaging and patient guide
text: We had a lovely visit at the Alcázar with Julio. He was super friendly and patient- he never made us feel rushed to get through the tour. He was very knowledgeable and good at keeping us engaged in the history he was sharing with us. It turned out to be a very busy day at the Alcazar but Julio did a good job taking us to less crowded spots when possible. Having a guide like Julio made the experience much richer and more memorable for all of us. Gracias Julio!
author: Jennifer_C

title: Great choice
text: Mandatory visit. Aliz a person with a lot of knowledge and made our visit very enjoyable. Then you have time to walk around the gardens.
author: Alfredo C

title: Must do tour of Alcazar Palace
text: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable, provided fascinating history of Alcazar palace, which made our tour a highlight of our stay in Seville!
author: pattiwL8200AE

title: Excellent.
text: Lou was an excellent guide. She had amazing knowledge of the history of Real Alcatraz and Spain. She answered all our questions. She took time to explain everything and made the whole tour enjoyable.
author: Steph S

title: Visit to the Alcázar de Sevilla
text:
We did the Tour of the Alcazar of Seville and it was very entertaining, especially thanks to our Guide Julian. The common thread of Julian’s history of the Alcazar was sensational, helping to understand the visit much more and to value everything we saw.
Then when the guided tour ended we could walk around the gardens. It's worth investing an hour strolling through that wonder.
We'll do it again when we get back to Seville
author: A4432KXpabloc

title: Aliz great guide!
text: We did the 2:30 tour to get to know Seville with Aliz and it was lucky! We couldn't have gotten a better guide! Local and with much to tell 🫶🏻 Super recommended! It has guided us through the history of Seville in a very dynamic and entertaining way, as well as recommending many places to eat and drink!
author: anem880

title: Guides Cristina (district of Juderia ) and Juanma (for Alcazar ) the reasons for the success of the two excursions
text: Excellent knowledge of the places visited by the two guides Cristina (Juderia) and Juanma (Alcazar). Competent and nice. Cristina made us understand everything while speaking only in Spanish. Juanma instead spoke good Italian. Interesting and fascinating places. Recommended these tours
author: Giovanni C
